sources.title: Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) | University of Sunderland
quotes: Why did you choose your specific course
What makes it better than similar courses
How they connect to your chosen course
What job do you want after graduating?
What do you know about Sunderland
Any previous travel to the UK or other countries
How will you pay for your studies and living costs
You will leave the UK when your visa expires
Why did you choose the UK instead of other countries
sources.notes: University-run Pre-CAS process: a four-part pre-CAS questionnaire (course selection, UK research, post-study plans, accommodation) plus a Pre-CAS interview. 'If you do not pass the Pre-CAS interview, we cannot continue with your application.' Snippet: 'research courses, accommodation, and the city of Sunderland'. Page itself does not name CAS Shield/Enroly; CAS Shield use is evidenced only by the Student Room thread title below.
